response.sql: WITH fee_orders AS (SELECT o.orderbase, f.feerate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL), channel_avgs AS (SELECT orderbase, AVG(feerate) as avg_feerate FROM fee_orders GROUP BY orderbase), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(feerate) as bench_rate FROM fee_orders), above_benchmark AS (SELECT avg_feerate, avg_feerate - (SELECT bench_rate FROM benchmark) as excess FROM channel_avgs WHERE avg_feerate > (SELECT bench_rate FROM benchmark)) SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) as mean_avg_rates, AVG(excess) as mean_excess FROM above_benchmark;
